definitions.gloss: pluck; combativeness; readiness to take someone on
definitions.explanation: A disposition to face an opponent or difficulty head-on rather than backing down. Carries a note of youthful boldness that can shade into recklessness, and is most often used of someone who is outmatched but refuses to yield.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{向|む}こう{気|き}が{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: He is a scrappy sort who never backs down.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}いころは{向|む}こう{気|き}ばかり{強|つよ}かった。
examples.english: When I was young I was all fight and no sense.

examples.japanese: {向|む}こう{気|き}の{強|つよ}さだけで{勝|か}てるほど{甘|あま}い{世界|せかい}ではない。
examples.english: This is not a world where sheer combativeness alone is enough to win.

notes:
Almost always appears with {強|つよ}い — the bare noun is rarely used on its own. The evaluation is mixed: admiring of the courage, wary of the lack of judgment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {向|む}こう{気|き}が{強|つよ}い: to be plucky; to never back down
- {向|む}こう{気|き}の{強|つよ}い{性格|せいかく}: a combative temperament
- {向|む}こう{気|き}だけは{人一倍|ひといちばい}: to have more fight in one than anybody

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {負|ま}けん{気|き}: competitive spirit — hating to lose, without the sense of squaring up to an opponent
- {気|き}が{強|つよ}い: strong-willed — general assertiveness, not tied to confrontation
- {血気|けっき}: hot-bloodedness — more literary, emphasizes youthful impetuousness
